entries.scope: Bind sandbox storage maintenance to the verified effective npm cache path
entries.rationale: The sandbox keeps its project-specific storage implementation while aligning the npm cache cleanup boundary with the Level-0 source fix.
entries.navigationImpact: The existing storage manpage remains the operator entry point.
entries.languageStrategy: German first and equivalent English in the bilingual manpage and ledger.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: The focused npm boundary tests and the complete owning storage test module pass on macOS; PR CI must confirm other platforms.
entries.risk: An .npmrc could redirect npm cleanup away from the cache path checked by the sandbox storage maintainer.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: The npm cache configuration or project-specific storage provider changes.
